title: Modeling the temporal dynamics of master regulators and CtrA proteolysis in Caulobacter crescentus cell cycle.
authors: Xu, Chunrui; Hollis, Henry; Dai, Michelle; Yao, Xiangyu; Watson, Layne T; Cao, Yang; Chen, Minghan
one_liner_zh: 该文用常微分方程建模Caulobacter细胞周期中主调控蛋白与CtrA蛋白水解的时间动态，属于纯系统生物学调控网络模拟，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The cell cycle of Caulobacter crescentus involves the polar morphogenesis and an asymmetric cell division driven by precise interactions and regulations of proteins, which makes Caulobacter an ideal model organism for investigating bacterial cell development and differentiation. The abundance of molecular data accumulated on Caulobacter motivates system biologists to analyze the complex regulatory network of cell cycle via quantitative modeling. In this paper, We propose a comprehensive model to accurately characterize the underlying mechanisms of cell cycle regulation based on the study of: a) chromosome replication and methylation; b) interactive pathways of five master regulatory proteins including DnaA, GcrA, CcrM, CtrA, and SciP, as well as novel consideration of their corresponding mRNAs; c) cell cycle-dependent proteolysis of CtrA through hierarchical protease complexes. The temporal dynamics of our simulation results are able to closely replicate an extensive set of experimental observations and capture the main phenotype of seven mutant strains of Caulobacter crescentus. Collectively, the proposed model can be used to predict phenotypes of other mutant cases, especially for nonviable strains which are hard to cultivate and observe. Moreover, the module of cyclic proteolysis is an efficient tool to study the metabolism of proteins with similar mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 新月柄杆菌（Caulobacter crescentus）的细胞周期涉及极性形态发生和由蛋白质精确相互作用与调控驱动的不对称细胞分裂，这使其成为研究细菌细胞发育与分化的理想模式生物。新月柄杆菌积累的大量分子数据促使系统生物学家通过定量建模分析细胞周期的复杂调控网络。本文中，我们提出了一个综合模型，以准确刻画细胞周期调控的潜在机制，基于以下研究：a) 染色体复制与甲基化；b) 五种主调控蛋白（包括DnaA、GcrA、CcrM、CtrA和SciP）的相互作用通路，并新考虑了它们对应的mRNA；c) 通过层级蛋白酶复合物对CtrA进行细胞周期依赖性蛋白水解。我们模拟结果的时间动态能够紧密复现大量实验观察，并捕捉新月柄杆菌七种突变株的主要表型。总体而言，所提出的模型可用于预测其他突变案例的表型，特别是难以培养和观察的非存活菌株。此外，循环蛋白水解模块是研究具有相似机制蛋白质代谢的有效工具。
